source_text: Vendor must provide a status report to Customer every 30 days.
notes: MUST + EVERY (recurring). Note this obligation carries no outer bound of its own -- v1's EVERY form has no companion DURING slot (a single obligation gets one temporal node, not a composition). The recurrence's real-world outer bound (e.g. 'during the Term') is left implicit to the source document's own effective_date/expiration, not re-encoded here -- see examples/not-supported/every-during-composition.json for the case this explicitly cannot represent.
